turns.content: Cube C1 has volume 125. Calculate its edge length a1.
Sphere S_n is circumscribed about cube C_n and inscribed in cube C_{n+1}. Set the edge a_{n+1} equal to twice the diameter of S_n.
Use the space diagonal of a cube to derive the recurrence for a_{n+1} in terms of a_n.
Check the recurrence geometrically by comparing the circumsphere radius of C_n with the insphere radius of C_{n+1}.
Derive closed forms for the edge length a_n and the volume V_n of C_n.
Calculate the edge lengths and volumes of C2 and C3.
Using the resulting cube net and edge values, find the least k for which V_k is at least 2019 and give the edge length of C_k.
